text:
emma (Marketing): Drafting a slim one-pager + launch post for enterprise secure deploys. Goal: single-page exec, one benchmark callout, short webinar (30m), and inbound routing snippet for infra. Quick review please.

noor (Product): Nice minimal approach. Add a single line on model pinning and graceful fallback to reduced-capacity variants. Also mention KMS support for Private.

liam (Field): Suggested benchmark blurb: test profile = 120 concurrent steady clients, seq=300, model=redwood-core-quant. Show p50/p95/p99 for Hosted and Dedicated. Example numbers (for collateral): Hosted p50=135ms p95=260ms p99=420ms; Dedicated p50=36ms p95=60ms p99=95ms; throughput ~140 req/s per GPU. Include short note: "measured with auto-batching; results vary by model family and sequence length."

ojas (Sales): For inbound routing: tag leads with {tier:enterprise, interest:private-deploy, compliance:requires-audit}. Route enterprise+private to AE-Enterprise; if requires-audit also alert compliance queue. Capture expected peak qps on form; add urgency checkbox.

liam (Field): Minimal routing snippet for infra (YAML):
```yaml
routing_rules:
  - match: tags.tier == 'enterprise' && tags.interest == 'private-deploy'
    route_to: queue.AE-Enterprise
    priority: 85
  - match: tags.compliance == 'requires-audit'
    route_to: queue.compliance-escalation
    priority: 95
  - fallback: queue.SDR-inbound
```

noor (Product): SLA blurb suggestion: "SLA: 99.95% monthly uptime for Dedicated plans. Latency SLOs published per deployment; customers can request custom SLOs for on-prem contracts. Automatic model-variant fallback minimizes hard failures during capacity events."

emma (Marketing): Webinar sketch: 30m -> 6m market framing, 10m demo (deploy modes + console quick tour), 10m benchmark & methodology, 4m Q&A/CTAs. CTA: request private trial + schedule tech deep-dive. Ojas will handle CTAs and Q&A.

infra-bot: Assets uploaded: /assets/slim-launch/onepager-v1.pdf and /assets/slim-launch/webinar-landing.html. Docs stub: https://playbook.internal/slim-launch.

liam (Field): Two-line customer blurb suggestion for slide 1: "OrbitBank ran a 2-week Private pilot on Redwood Dedicated and reduced inference run cost by ~2.4x while meeting 99.95% uptime. Pilot used dedicated GPUs in their VPC with full audit logging."

emma (Marketing): Two quick asks before I finalize v1: (1) @liam confirm OrbitBank blurb OK to publish, (2) @noor confirm Dedicated p99 figure. If both OK I'll publish the one-pager and send the webinar invite. Thanks! :sparkles:
